newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber higher on Tokyo, short covering.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber higher on Tokyo, short covering.

text.p: Rubber futures ended higher on Wednesday on good buying interest, helped by firmer levels in Tokyo, brokers said.
They said the higher pries were spurred by firm cash market sentiment and short covering by some traders.
They said Tokyo rubber futures had also moved higher on short covering and expected delays in Thai rubber tapping caused by monsoon rains.
At the close, benchmark December RSS3 rose 2.75 cents from its previous settlement to close at 132 U.S cents a kg.
November RSS1 closed 2.50 Singapore cents (1.79 U.S cents) higher at 191.50 Singapore cents (US 137 cents).
November TSR20 rose by just one Singapore cent (0.7 U.S cents) to end at 180.50 Singapore cents (128.9 U.S cents).
